narratives.headline: Iran Ceasefire Fractures: UAE Hit by Iranian Missiles, Strait of Hormuz Closure Risk Resurges
narratives.summary: Iran's missile/drone attack on the UAE collapsed ceasefire expectations, spiking Brent crude above $112 and WTI above $104, steepening Treasury yields 6-10bps, crushing rate-sensitive and industrial equities while giving a bid to energy stocks and injecting inflation-premium volatility across all risk assets including Bitcoin.

narratives.headline: Fed Leadership Transition Imminent: Powell Stays on Board as Kevin Warsh Confirmation Set for May 15
narratives.summary: With the Fed holding rates at 3.5–3.75% amid a historic 8-4 dissent and Powell's successor Kevin Warsh set to take the chair on May 15, markets face a policy-uncertainty repricing as new leadership may tilt hawkish on energy-driven inflation, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors and resetting the forward curve.

narratives.headline: Amazon Launches Supply Chain Services: Existential Threat to UPS, FedEx, and the Logistics Duopoly
narratives.summary: Amazon's opening of its full logistics stack to third-party enterprises (modeled on the AWS playbook) sent FedEx -9% and UPS -10% in a single session, with broader freight names including GXO and Old Dominion also cratering as markets price in structural margin destruction across the legacy parcel industry.

narratives.headline: Hyperscaler AI CapEx Confirmed at ~$725B for 2026: Nvidia Earnings May 20 Becomes the Market's Pivotal Event
narratives.summary: Q1 earnings confirmed combined hyperscaler AI capex guidance of ~$725B, with Meta, Amazon, Microsoft, and Alphabet all raising or maintaining massive spending plans, creating a direct positive demand signal for Nvidia ahead of its May 20 report and sustaining the semiconductor/data-center equity rally.

narratives.headline: CLARITY Act Stablecoin Compromise Reached: Bipartisan Senate Deal Unlocks Crypto Regulatory Catalyst
narratives.summary: Senators Tillis and Alsobrooks releasing bipartisan compromise language on the CLARITY Act's stablecoin yield provisions removes a key regulatory overhang, directly lifting crypto-adjacent equities like Coinbase and Circle and providing a legislative tailwind that could accelerate institutional capital inflows into digital assets over the next 30 days.

SLB.transmission: Iran missile attack on UAE collapses ceasefire → Brent crude spikes above $112 → elevated oil prices incentivize upstream E&P capital spending → direct demand surge for SLB's oilfield services, drilling, and completions business → revenue and margin expansion
